steps.title: Lesson 2: Core Concepts
steps.body: Key Facts: Bristol is a city in south-west England with a population of approximately 470,000 (wider metro area 725,000). It is the largest city in the South West and the 8th largest in England. It has a diverse economy, two universities, and a rich cultural heritage. Bristol was European Green Capital in 2015. | Geography Exam Tips — Urban Change in the UK: 1. For Urban Change in the UK questions, always name specific case studies with factual detail 2. Use geographical terminology precisely (e.g. specific processes, not vague descriptions) 3. Consider social, economic and environmental perspectives in your evaluations 4. steps.body: Explain how international migration has affected a named UK city. (4 marks) | Describe two challenges of urban change in a named UK city. (4 marks) | Using a named UK city, assess the impact of urban regeneration. (6 marks)
